answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 3 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in ember, checked in fable, and saffron shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 4927 identities would post 1990 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
